findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: swap_quote, prepare_signing · Private data: swap_quote, swap_build, double_quote, double_build, nn_quote, nn_build, prepare_signing, report_execution, swap_status · Public sink: swap_build, nn_build, prepare_signing · Destructive: swap_build, double_build, nn_quote, prepare_signing.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: swap_quote, prepare_signing · Private data: swap_quote, swap_build, double_quote, double_build, nn_quote, nn_build, prepare_signing, report_execution, swap_status · Public sink: swap_build, nn_build, prepare_signing · Destructive: swap_build, double_build, nn_quote, prepare_signing

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
